name: Sun Cleric
description: A devoted servant of An'she's holy light.

specs.name: Piety
specs.description: Wield sanctified flame and holy wrath in tandem, searing corruption away and reducing enemies into purified ash.

specs.name: Valkyrie
specs.description: Become the Light's wrath made flesh, carving through foes with a greatblade in each hand as a storm of merciless holy steel.

specs.name: Seraphim
specs.description: Swear a radiant oath to guard your allies — becoming a shield bearer that turns the wrath of the sun into impenetrable defense.

specs.name: Blessings
specs.description: A radiant healer who weaves blessings of restoration, mending the wounded with golden light and shielding allies from harm.
